fee_notes: Royalty is 7% of weekly gross sales for Traditional locations and 6% for Non-Traditional locations, paid weekly. Marketing Fee is 2% of weekly gross sales. Regional Cooperative Marketing Contribution is capped so that total advertising contributions (Marketing Fee + regional cooperative) do not exceed 5% of gross sales over any 12-month period. Digital Menu Software Monthly Service Fee: $49–$60/month. POS System Software Subscription: $50–$70 per POS per month. Gift Card Redemption Fee: 5–11% of gift card redemption amount (currently not charged but may be in future). Lease Guarantee Fee: 10% of total guaranteed amount, up to $10,000 maximum. Successor Franchise Fee: $15,000. Transfer Fee: $15,000. Security Deposit: estimated $15,000–$75,000 (equal to three months gross rent). Lease Administration Fee: $8,000. Rent: $5,000–$25,000/month. Sublease Fee: $500–$2,500. Special Assistance Fee: $500/day per person. Development Construction Fee: greater of $2,500 or 3% of total development cost, up to $15,000 maximum. Training for Replacement Manager: $3,000 plus expenses. Relocation Charge: $500. Administration Fee for Franchisee Programs: up to 15% of gross costs. Supplemental/Refresher Training: $3,000 plus expenses. Non-participation Fee: $100/day. Document Administration Fee: $500. Dishonored Check Fee: $25. Early Termination Fee: average monthly Royalty and Advertising Fees for any consecutive 12-month period in preceding 48 months multiplied by remaining months divided by 2.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Traditional 7% of weekly gross sales / Non-Traditional: 6% of weekly gross sales / Payable on Thursday each week based upon the seven day period ending on the immediately preceding Sunday night / Gross sales includes all the revenues from your Restaurant but not any sales tax you pay.
Marketing Fee 2% of weekly gross sales / Payable at the same time as the Royalty / You must contribute this amount to our advertising fund.
Regional Cooperative Marketing Contribution / Your proportionate share of regional and local advertising and public relations programs will not exceed an amount that, when added to the amount you pay for your Marketing Fee, is greater than 5% of your gross sales over any 12 month period. / Monthly as required by your regional cooperative. / Payable only if a cooperative is formed in your area.
Digital Menu Software Monthly Service Fee $49 to $60 Monthly / Payable to the system provider at the beginning of each month
POS System Software Subscription $50 to $70 / POS Monthly / Payable to the system provider at the beginning of each month
